title: Lyrical genius Braxton Cook brings the perfect song at the perfect time with his feel-good Summer jam "Indie"
htmlContent:
Braxton Cook is a multi-talented music star who finds himself in music and is currently based in America. He is a world-class alto saxophonist, vocalist, and composer who is now making many waves with the release of the recent song "Indie." He is a hard-headed, confident, and an expressive young artist who is determined to make a name for himself in this harsh industry.

Braxton, on his recent song "Indie," reflects on his humble beginnings as an independent artist, learning under his mentor Christian Scott, touring with Tom Misch, recording with Phony Ppl, Jon Batiste, and many more. Braxton Cook brings a daring sound of music that flourishes in the innovative place it is.
